observations: WHO reports 44 pneumonia cases of unknown cause in Wuhan as of 3 January, 11 severe.
Cause unconfirmed at publication; no clear evidence of substantial person-to-person transmission in preliminary reporting.
WHO advises against travel and trade restrictions based on then available information.
ECDC reports 59 possible cases between 31 December and 5 January.
ECDC considers importation risk to Europe low but not zero; notes limited evidence.
WHO reports 41 confirmed cases and one death, with a novel coronavirus identified.
No clear evidence of human-to-human transmission at publication; genetic sequence shared on 12 January.

analyst_tasks: List plausible public-health scenarios and uncertainty without claiming a global pandemic is certain.
Describe conditional economic transmission channels for travel, supply chains, healthcare, and market risk.
Identify missing evidence that would change the scenario probabilities.
verification_notes: Date-only publications conservatively treated as available by 23:59:59 UTC on publication date.
Not yet a validated market-data backtest; dated price series and archival capture still required.
